experiment.cpu_fallback: the same readiness run on the real host inventory, and mlock/munlock registration cost versus size (no cudaHostRegister or pinned-vs-pageable copy without a GPU)
experiment.title: Lab 8 L2: readiness validator on this host's real inventory, and memory-registration cost

needs: 2+ hosts with RDMA NICs (RoCEv2 or InfiniBand) on a lab fabric
not_runnable_parts.part: perftest per rail (ib_write_bw -a --report_gbits, ib_write_lat -a) between two hosts

needs: a kernel with the rdma_rxe module
a real netdev (the harness runs with --network none)
not_runnable_parts.part: Soft-RoCE stand-in (rdma link add rxe0 type rxe netdev <if>)

notes: Inventory sections are the real command output where the tool exists; ip -o link and lsmod are rendered from /sys/class/net and /proc/modules in those tools' formats (see tables.inventory_provenance).
The host is labelled l2host-01 because check_node derives the node index from a trailing number.
Registration timing: perf_counter around each call, 2 warm-ups, then >= 5 repetitions per size; the buffer's pages are touched first so the cost measured is pinning, not page allocation.
